mission: Follow-up to Mission 4 (issue #273) freshness signal. A never-checked mapping counts as overdue only 24h after source_card_mappings.created_at (deadline anchored on coalesce(last successful check, created_at)). The same rule is in DUE_SQL overdue and over_24h, the freshness evidence behind quarantine_reporting.deficit, and the run-level never_checked_overdue count that classify uses. first_collection_pending (never checked, created less than 24h ago) is reported per source beside quarantined_refresh_work and does not cause DEGRADED or BLOCKED. The 24h target, the 23h dispatch point, identity-refusal DEGRADED, and every BLOCKED rule are unchanged. These modules are collector runtime inputs, so delivery re-uploads the ten collectors.

impacts.reason: The shared freshness deadline used by the state generator and by collector run receipts. Infrastructure: mission-scoped re-upload of the ten collectors, because these modules are on both collector import graphs. Collection selection, the 23h dispatch point, identity checks and prices are unchanged.

The staging-state freshness deficit ignores mappings still inside their first 24h, reports first_collection_pending beside quarantined refresh work, and degraded-signals carries an old-versus-new overdue comparison. Quarantined work stays outside the deficit.

Operator-visible cases: created 1h ago stays HEALTHY with first_collection_pending 1; created 25h ago or checked 25h ago is DEGRADED due_work_deficit; quarantined work stays beside the deficit; an identity refusal stays DEGRADED.

routes: No new route. No extra source request from this change.
impact.deployment_impact: Each collector is re-uploaded on the merge commit in its own slot, with automatic rollback to the deployment captured before upload. Must start 06:00-23:00 UTC. The API rebuilds through its existing GitHub watch because services/api changed. No schema change.

recovery.procedure: The rollout captures each collector's live deployment before upload and restores it on failure (recovery_deployment_id rows are reference only, carried from the last full-fleet mission). Afterwards collector-redeploy to the fleet pin. Code: native revert PR with its own mission file.
recovery.trigger: A collector failing after release, or a source marked DEGRADED for a mapping created less than 24h ago that has never been checked.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema change and no row written by this PR.

verification.observation_window: Delivery verify, including natural collector receipts on the merge commit. Then ops-readonly db-diagnostic degraded-signals, statement old_vs_new_overdue: difference equals first_collection_pending per source.
